communication.evidence:
I’ve escalated the refund request for the second pair of headphones to our specialist team.

It is within the electronics return window and a photo is on the order. However, the first pair’s ₹3,099 refund means the cumulative refund for this order would reach ₹6,099, which is above my ₹5,000 authority limit. No return or refund has been created yet.

values.user_request: Refund for the other pair of Wireless headphones because it does not work.
values.facts_found: Verified user U022. Order O0049 was delivered on 2026-09-11; item I0052 is Wireless headphones (electronics), priced ₹3,000. Claim is within the 7-calendar-day electronics return window (today 2026-09-15), and a photo is uploaded. The other headphones, I0051, already received a completed defective/damaged refund of ₹3,099 (₹3,000 item plus ₹99 shipping) on 2026-09-13. Shipping may be refunded only once per order, so I0052 would be ₹3,000 after pickup, but cumulative refunds on O0049 would become ₹6,099.
values.rule_triggered: E9 and H2: return/damage refunds above ₹5,000 cumulatively on one order, including prior refunded shipping, must be escalated.
values.what_user_was_told: I explained that the second headphones are eligible for a defective-item return, but the cumulative-refund authority limit requires specialist review. No return or refund was created.
